title: fix(scenarios): the run grader reads a written calendar date ("31 Dec") as no figure
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X9GF8q7Br6jm5Yk5d7UFpR1)_

domain:devx#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5nw3MDkRymEzv6FDJs

Fixes #33754

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:场景评分器读数字时,除了 ISO 日期,现在也跳过回复里写出来的日历日期(`31 Dec`、`Dec 31, 2026`、`December 2026`、`31/12/2026`、`12月31日`),日期里的数字不再当成「数据」。
- 为什么改:`asset_lifecycle` 的 `laptop_warranty_expiring`(无法回答的问题)里,agent 正确拒答,顺带说「36 个月折旧期到 31 Dec 结束的笔记本可以列给你」;36 有工具输出佐证,但 `31 Dec` 里的 31 被当成没有依据的数字,判「stated a figure the data cannot support」,挡住了 gallery 导出。
- 风险与回滚:只扩了数字读取器的日期跳过;月份名只认首字母大写(`may` 是动词)、斜杠日期必须带年(`3/4` 是分数)、不挨着月份的数字照读,所以编造的数量或金额(「about 12 laptops」「$4,200 due by 31 Dec」)仍然判失败。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-run-grade.ts` 的 `WRITTEN_DATE`(L136)和 `readingsIn` 里的跳过(L208)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/score/scenario-run-grade.test.ts test/runner/mid-tier-run-readings.test.ts`,预期 109 条全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## Ask 1: which number failed

Replayed the card's quoted sentences ("The Laptop category gives a 36-month useful life", "… whose 36-month depreciation life ends by 31 Dec") through `numbersIn` (the reader `writtenNumbers` uses) against an output carrying `"useful_life_months": 36`, read by `jsonNumbers` as `carriedNumbers` does:

```text
written: [36, 36, 31]    carried: {36, …}    unsupported: [31]
```

So **the `31` of "31 Dec" failed**; `36` was carried (`36-month` reads 36, and the JSON number reads 36). No year was in the quoted reply. The carried side is unchanged.

## What changes

`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-run-grade.ts`:

- `WRITTEN_DATE` (L136, with `MONTH` L122 and `DAY` L124) is a calendar date written out:
  - a day and a month name in either order (`31 Dec`, `31st of December 2026`, `Dec 31, 2026`, `Dec. 31`);
  - a month name with its year (`December 2026`, `Sept 2026`);
  - a slash date with its year (`31/12/2026`, `12/31/26`, `2026/12/31`);
  - a Chinese date (`12月31日`, `2026年12月`, `2026年12月31号`).
- `readingsIn` (L205) blanks it the way it already blanks `ISO_DATE` (L208), so none of its parts is read. `numbersIn` and `writtenNumbers` read through it. The docblocks say so.
- What stays a figure: a month name only reads capitalised (`you may 3` reads 3), a slash pair with no year (`3/4`, `12/31`) is not a date, a number beside no month name is still read, and a month count (`36-month`, `36 months`, `36个月`) is a figure. No small integer is skipped by size.

The unanswerable branch itself (L716, `supported = writtenNumbers(...).every(...)`) is unchanged. #33763's decline reader is not touched.

## Tests

- `test/score/scenario-run-grade.test.ts`, new `describe` (L546), on `PersonaRunInput` with an unanswerable truth and a `query_records demoasset_asset_category` output carrying `"useful_life_months":36`:
  - **the card's reply** reads `[36, 36]` and grades `correct: true, problems: []` (L560);
  - **written dates** (L565): each of the 15 forms above reads no number;
  - **not a date** (L574): `3/4 of them, 12/31, you may 3` reads `[3, 4, 12, 31, 3]`; `a 36-month life, 36 months, 36个月, 共3台` reads `[36, 36, 36, 3]`; `Rows 12-15 of 120, about 12 laptops` reads `[12, 15, 120, 12]`;
  - **an invented count or amount still fails** (L580): "There are about 12 laptops.", "there are 7 expiring", "$4,200 is due by 31 Dec.", "7 expire by Dec 31, 2026." each grade `correct: false, problems: ['stated a figure the data cannot support']`.
- `test/runner/mid-tier-run-readings.test.ts`, new `describe` R5 (L955): the re-grade below.

**Ablation** (head `30089f51`, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `.replace(WRITTEN_DATE, (d) => ' '.repeat(d.length))` in `readingsIn` deleted, anchor 1 → 0, blob `1318c6902e1c` → `e65a2bd754e3`; tests import `src/`):

<details><summary>Ablated: 3 failed | 103 passed (106); restored: 106 passed</summary>

```text
× the 31 of "31 Dec" was the unsupported figure; the 36 is carried
× a written calendar date states no figure: none of its parts is read
× the recorded turn replays and grades correct; the same decline inventing a count still fails
Test Files  2 failed (2) · Tests  3 failed | 103 passed (106)
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (1318c6902e1c) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```

</details>

The negatives stay green under the ablation, as they should: they pin that the skip does not reach a count or an amount.

## Ask 3: re-grade (fixture, not the recording)

The 08:3xZ refresh's recording is not in this repository or the project's shared files, so a one-turn recorded-driver fixture replays the turn: `test/runner/fixtures/asset-lifecycle-warranty-unanswerable.recording.json`, key `asset_lifecycle/scratch/run/laptop_warranty_expiring/-` (no persona scopes the question, so run-ask asks it as the admin).

- **What is recorded and what is written here.** The reply carries the card's two quoted sentences; its other sentences are written here from the card's account. The one tool call is `query_records demoasset_asset_category`, whose output is the card's four seeded categories, so it carries `"useful_life_months": 36` as the card says.
- **The grade.** R5 replays it with `RecordedDriver.fromFile` and grades it with `gradeCardAnswer(namespacedScenario(asset_lifecycle), { question, turn })`, as `orchestrate.ts` run-ask does. It now reads `correct: true, declined: true, problems: []`, and was a fail (ablated: the 31 unsupported).
- **Control.** The same turn with "About 12 laptops are likely to run out by 31 Dec." appended still fails.
- **Not done.** A full `--driver recorded:F` CLI replay needs every build turn's files and a booted app, which one turn cannot drive. The card says the question failed "in both halves"; the Iterate half's turn is not on the card, so the fixture replays the Run half only.

## Acceptance notes

- **Observed, not changed: "Mar 12 assets".** A capitalised month name followed by a number now reads as a date, so a reply that writes "In March 12 assets were checked out" reads no 12. That is the order's "day + month name in either order" taken as written; such wording is rare and ambiguous for a reader too. class: observation · reach: none · carrier: none.
- **Observed, not changed: the slash rule.** A slash date with no year (`12/31`) still reads both numbers, because the same shape is a fraction (`3/4`). class: observation · reach: none (no recorded reply writes one) · carrier: none.
- **The shared reader.** `readingsIn` serves the answerable grades and the leak readings too, so a written date's parts are no longer read there either: a date is not a count or an amount in any of them, as for ISO dates today.
- **#33763 landed first.** It edits the decline reader in the same file, away from these lines; `origin/main` was merged in (never rebased) at `e1d2a7dd`. The only conflict was both PRs appending a `describe` at the end of `scenario-run-grade.test.ts`; both are kept. The gates were rerun on the merged head. A later main commit (#33764, the recorded driver's writes) merges cleanly; a trial merge ran the two touched test files green (109) and was aborted, so it is not in this branch.

## Verification

On head `e1d2a7dd` (branch `claude/project-thread-rl158j`, `origin/main` merged in at `25c1d3c7`), each exit code captured before any pipe:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test`: exit 0, Test Files 32 passed (32), Tests 790 passed (790).

- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, 62 families): all 62 exit 0, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` included. `--ran`: "62 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". The first run, on `abf2659c` before the merge, read 61 exit 0 and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (NOT MEASURED).
- `dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate. 143 changed lines, under the 3000 threshold. No governed surface.
